path

Trainer!

and take
center stage cute as can be! ☆

center
stage...

text_block_list.text:

lost...
Come on, Falco! You gotta get a
grip!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's do it as soon as we get back!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna work harder than ever to
become a top
Umadol!
